breakdown.description: Split the series by a dimension.
breakdown.title: Breakdown

breakdown_key.description: Metadata field to group by when breakdown='metadata'.
breakdown_key.title: Breakdown Key

dashboard.description: Replay a saved chart: the dashboard's id or name.
dashboard.title: Dashboard

end.description: ISO-8601 window end. Defaults to now.
end.title: End

filters.description: Opik filter objects — {field, operator, value, key?} — applied to the metric's own entity (traces, spans or threads).
filters.title: Filters

interval.description: Bucket size: hourly, daily, weekly, total, or 'auto' (default) to pick one from the window.
interval.title: Interval

max_points.description: Cap on points per series (most recent kept).
max_points.title: Max Points

metric.description: Metric to chart, e.g. 'trace_count', 'duration', 'cost', 'feedback_scores', 'span_token_usage'. Optional only when replaying a saved widget via dashboard+widget.
metric.title: Metric

project_ids.description: Chart several projects at once (max 10); each is returned as its own series.
project_ids.title: Project Ids

sub_metric.description: Which series to keep under a breakdown: a percentile (p50/p90/p99) for duration metrics, the score name for feedback scores, the usage key for token usage.
sub_metric.title: Sub Metric

widget.description: Which chart on that dashboard, by widget_id or title — from read('dashboard', …).charts[]. Optional when it holds one chart.
widget.title: Widget

window.description: Relative window ending now: '24h', '7d', '4w', '3m'. Defaults to '7d'. Ignored when start/end are given.
window.title: Window
